description.short: Ask Otto in plain language about your mail, chats, meetings and files.
description.full: Otto is an agent user that answers plain-language questions about Microsoft 365 work data through WorkIQ, signed in as his own identity. Chat with him 1:1 or @mention him in group chats and channels. He can summarize threads, start group chats and post summaries after you confirm, post Adaptive Cards, stream progress in 1:1 chats, and listen to group chats and offer to help with incidents (he always asks before acting).
